article_title: Action Research in Urban Schools: Empowerment, Transformation, and Challenges
citation: Razfar, A. (2011). Action Research in Urban Schools: Empowerment, Transformation, and Challenges. Teacher Education Quarterly, 38(4), 25-44. https://eric.ed.gov/?id=EJ949874
title: NVivo qualitative software for organizing and coding action research data
description: The teacher-researchers were trained in the uses of NVivo qualitative software to assist them in organizing and coding their participatory observation field-notes, daily reflective journals, video tape-log summaries where applicable, recorded interviews, recorded focus group discussions, and material artifacts. The tool supported the iterative nature of action research across the two-year period.
requirements: Training in the uses of NVivo qualitative software
key_sources: Razfar, A. (2011). Action Research in Urban Schools: Empowerment, Transformation, and Challenges. Teacher Education Quarterly, 38(4), 25-44. https://eric.ed.gov/?id=EJ960617

article_title: Novel high-quality and reality biomaterial as a kidney surgery simulation model.
citation: Kubo Taro, Takayama Tatsuya, Fujisaki Akira, Nakamura Shigeru, Teratani Takumi, Sata Naohiro, Kitayama Joji, Nakai Hideo, Iwami Daiki, Fujimura Tetsuya. (2022). Novel high-quality and reality biomaterial as a kidney surgery simulation model. PLoS ONE. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0263179
title: NVP-fixed kidney surgical training model with controlled water-reflux washing protocol
description: A surgical training model made from Göttingen Minipig kidneys fixed with N-vinyl-2-pyrrolidone and washed by water perfusion. The protocol is that "Kidney fixation was first refluxed with FA or NVP fixative for 1 hour in its bath, followed by permeation for 23 hours, and then the kidneys were refluxed with freshwater for 48 hours as the washing step." The model mimics fresh-kidney hardness and strength, supports blood-like fluid perfusion and electrocautery, and is used for partial nephrectomy simulation training.
requirements: Arteriovenous access for organ perfusion must be secured without damaging the vascular system during organ harvesting
constraints: Handling of undiluted NVP requires the same care as formaldehyde, though the protocol uses diluted NVP followed by water perfusion
target_learning_goals: renal tissue incision, resection, and ligation skills
examples: The study used 26 Göttingen Minipig kidneys: 4 for hardness measurements, 20 for strength measurement, and 2 for reflux tests.
key_sources: Kubo Taro, Takayama Tatsuya, Fujisaki Akira, Nakamura Shigeru, Teratani Takumi, Sata Naohiro, Kitayama Joji, Nakai Hideo, Iwami Daiki, Fujimura Tetsuya. (2022). Novel high-quality and reality biomaterial as a kidney surgery simulation model. PLoS ONE. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0263179

article_title: Coherent control of NV- centers in diamond in a quantum teaching lab
citation: Vikas K. Sewani, Hyma H. Vallabhapurapu, Yang Yang, Hannes R. Firgau, Chris Adambukulam, Brett C. Johnson, Jarryd J. Pla, and Arne Laucht. (2020). Coherent control of NV − centers in diamond in a quantum teaching lab. https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.02643
title: Low-cost NV− coherent-control teaching lab apparatus assembled from off-the-shelf components and a custom PCB antenna
description: The setup is a room-temperature apparatus for coherent control of NV− electronic spins, combining a fiber-coupled 520 nm laser, microscope objective, dichroic filtering, photodiode detection, a SignalCore microwave source with I/Q modulator, a loop-gap-resonator PCB antenna, and a Pulse Blaster driving a lock-in amplifier. "All optical and electrical components were purchased oﬀ-the-shelf, while the printed circuit boards for the antenna [see Fig. 2(c)] and the laser current driver ... can be commercially manufactured", and Eagle CAD files are supplied in supplementary material.
requirements: A PC programs pulse sequences in Matlab and configures the Pulse Blaster over USB serial; four TTL channels (lock-in reference, laser modulation, and I/Q inputs) are required.
The antenna design must use the same FR4 substrate and 0.254 mm thickness, since modifications "will result in a shift in the resonant frequency" per Endnote 20.
constraints: Spin signal contrast is limited to a few percent when collecting all four NV− orientations, so lock-in detection is employed for robust extraction.
target_learning_goals: the rotating frame and Bloch sphere
examples: Two identical setups were built and operated simultaneously during lab times at UNSW Sydney; total assembly cost is stated as less than USD 20k, with itemized parts lists in Appendix A (Tables I and II).
key_sources: Vikas K. Sewani, Hyma H. Vallabhapurapu, Yang Yang, Hannes R. Firgau, Chris Adambukulam, Brett C. Johnson, Jarryd J. Pla, and Arne Laucht. (2020). Coherent control of NV − centers in diamond in a quantum teaching lab. https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.02643
